verses.greek: Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ ἀληθινή, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ γεωργός ἐστιν·
verses.literal: I myself am the vine the true and the Father of Mine the vinedresser is.
verses.dgt: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.

verses.greek: πᾶν κλῆμα ἐν ἐμοὶ μὴ φέρον καρπὸν αἴρει αὐτό, καὶ πᾶν τὸ καρπὸν φέρον καθαίρει αὐτὸ ἵνα καρπὸν πλείονα φέρῃ.
verses.literal: Every branch in Me myself not bearing fruit He takes away it and every one the fruit bearing He prunes it that fruit more it may bear.
verses.dgt: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit he takes away, and every one that bears fruit he prunes so that it may bear more fruit.

verses.greek: ἤδη ὑμεῖς καθαροί ἐστε διὰ τὸν λόγον ὃν λελάληκα ὑμῖν·
verses.literal: Already you yourselves clean are because of the word that I have spoken to you.
verses.dgt: You are already clean because of the word that I have spoken to you.

verses.greek: μείνατε ἐν ἐμοί, κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν. καθὼς τὸ κλῆμα οὐ δύναται καρπὸν φέρειν ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ ἐὰν μὴ μένῃ ἐν τῇ ἀμπέλῳ, οὕτως οὐδὲ ὑμεῖς ἐὰν μὴ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένητε.
verses.literal: do abide in Me myself and I myself in you. Even as the branch not is able fruit to bear of itself only unless it shall abide in the vine so neither are able you only unless in Me myself you shall abide.
verses.dgt: Remain in me, and I in you. Just as the branch cannot bear fruit from itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you unless you remain in me.

verses.greek: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἄμπελος, ὑμεῖς τὰ κλήματα. ὁ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν αὐτῷ οὗτος φέρει καρπὸν πολύν, ὅτι χωρὶς ἐμοῦ οὐ δύνασθε ποιεῖν οὐδέν.
verses.literal: I myself am the vine you are the branches. The one abiding in Me myself and I myself in him he bears fruit much For apart from Me not you are able to do no thing.
verses.dgt: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in me and I in him—this one bears much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.

verses.greek: ἐὰν μή τις μένῃ ἐν ἐμοί, ἐβλήθη ἔξω ὡς τὸ κλῆμα καὶ ἐξηράνθη, καὶ συνάγουσιν αὐτὰ καὶ εἰς τὸ πῦρ βάλλουσιν καὶ καίεται.
verses.literal: Only unless someone shall abide in Me myself he is thrown out like the branch and is dried up and they gather them and into the fire cast and it is burned.
verses.dgt: If anyone does not remain in me, he is thrown outside like the branch and dries up; and they gather them and throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.greek: ἐὰν μείνητε ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τὰ ῥήματά μου ἐν ὑμῖν μείνῃ, ὃ ἐὰν θέλητε αἰτήσασθε καὶ γενήσεται ὑμῖν·
verses.literal: If you shall abide in Me myself and the declarations of Mine in you shall abide whatever if you shall wish do yourself ask and it will happen to you.
verses.dgt: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you desire, and it will happen for you.

verses.greek: ἐν τούτῳ ἐδοξάσθη ὁ πατήρ μου ἵνα καρπὸν πολὺν φέρητε καὶ γένησθε ἐμοὶ μαθηταί.
verses.literal: In this is glorified the Father of Mine that fruit much you may bear and you may become to Me disciples.
verses.dgt: By this my Father is glorified: that you bear much fruit and become my disciples.

verses.greek: καθὼς ἠγάπησέν με ὁ πατήρ, κἀγὼ ὑμᾶς ἠγάπησα, μείνατε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐμῇ.
verses.literal: even as has loved Me the Father I myself also you loved do abide in the love the of Mine.
verses.dgt: Just as the Father loved me, I also loved you. Remain in my love.

verses.greek: ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολάς μου τηρήσητε, μενεῖτε ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ μου, καθὼς ἐγὼ τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ πατρός μου τετήρηκα καὶ μένω αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ.
verses.literal: If the commandments of Mine you shall keep you will abide in the love of Mine even as I myself the commandments of the Father of Mine have kept and I abide of Him in the love.
verses.dgt: If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commands and remain in his love.

verses.greek: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ ἐν ὑμῖν ᾖ καὶ ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν πληρωθῇ.
verses.literal: These things I have spoken to you that the joy the of Mine in you may be and the joy of you may be full.
verses.dgt: I have spoken these things to you so that my joy may be in you and your joy may be made full.

verses.greek: Αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἐντολὴ ἡ ἐμὴ ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους καθὼς ἠγάπησα ὑμᾶς·
verses.literal: This is the commandment the of Mine that you may love one another even as I loved you.
verses.dgt: This is my command: that you love one another just as I loved you.

verses.greek: μείζονα ταύτης ἀγάπην οὐδεὶς ἔχει, ἵνα τις τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ θῇ ὑπὲρ τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Greater than this love no one has that one the life of him may lay down for the friends of him.
verses.dgt: No one has greater love than this: that someone lay down his life for his friends.

verses.greek: ὑμεῖς φίλοι μού ἐστε ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἃ ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: You yourselves friends of Mine are if you shall do what things I myself command you.
verses.dgt: You are my friends if you do what I command you.

verses.greek: οὐκέτι λέγω ὑμᾶς δούλους, ὅτι ὁ δοῦλος οὐκ οἶδεν τί ποιεῖ αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος· ὑμᾶς δὲ εἴρηκα φίλους, ὅτι πάντα ἃ ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου ἐγνώρισα ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: no longer I name you servants for the servant not knows what is doing his the master You however I have called friends because all things that I heard from the Father of Mine I have made known to you.
verses.dgt: I no longer call you slaves, because the slave does not know what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I heard from my Father I made known to you.

verses.greek: οὐχ ὑμεῖς με ἐξελέξασθε, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἔθηκα ὑμᾶς ἵνα ὑμεῖς ὑπάγητε καὶ καρπὸν φέρητε καὶ ὁ καρπὸς ὑμῶν μένῃ, ἵνα ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου δῷ ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: Not you yourselves Me chose but I myself chose you and appointed you that you yourselves may go and fruit you may bear and the fruit of you may remain so that which one maybe you may ask the Father in the name of Me He may give you.
verses.dgt: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you would go and bear fruit, and your fruit would remain, so that whatever you ask the Father in my name he may give you.

verses.greek: ταῦτα ἐντέλλομαι ὑμῖν ἵνα ἀγαπᾶτε ἀλλήλους.
verses.literal: These things I command you that you may love one another.
verses.dgt: These things I command you, so that you love one another.

verses.greek: Εἰ ὁ κόσμος ὑμᾶς μισεῖ, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐμὲ πρῶτον ὑμῶν μεμίσηκεν.
verses.literal: If the world you hates you know that Me myself before you it has hated.
verses.dgt: If the world hates you, know that it hated me before you.

verses.greek: εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἦτε, ὁ κόσμος ἂν τὸ ἴδιον ἐφίλει· ὅτι δὲ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ ἐστέ, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου, διὰ τοῦτο μισεῖ ὑμᾶς ὁ κόσμος.
verses.literal: If of the world you were the world then would the as its own was loving you because however of the world not you are but I myself chose you out of the world on account of this hates you the world.
verses.dgt: If you were from the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not from the world, but I chose you out of the world, for this reason the world hates you.

verses.greek: μνημονεύετε τοῦ λόγου οὗ ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν· Οὐκ ἔστιν δοῦλος μείζων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ· εἰ ἐμὲ ἐδίωξαν, καὶ ὑμᾶς διώξουσιν· εἰ τὸν λόγον μου ἐτήρησαν, καὶ τὸν ὑμέτερον τηρήσουσιν.
verses.literal: do remember the word that I myself said to you: Not is a servant greater than the master of him. If Me myself they persecuted also you they will persecute if the word of Mine they kept also the yours they will keep.
verses.dgt: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα πάντα ποιήσουσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τὸν πέμψαντά με.
verses.literal: But these things all they will do against you on account of the name of Me because not they know the One having sent Me.
verses.dgt: But they will do all these things to you because of my name, because they do not know the one who sent me.

verses.greek: εἰ μὴ ἦλθον καὶ ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν· νῦν δὲ πρόφασιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: only unless I come and I said to them sin not they had now however excuse not they have for the sin of them.
verses.dgt: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.greek: ὁ ἐμὲ μισῶν καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου μισεῖ.
verses.literal: The one Me myself hating also the Father of Mine hates.
verses.dgt: The one who hates me hates my Father also.

verses.greek: εἰ τὰ ἔργα μὴ ἐποίησα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἃ οὐδεὶς ἄλλος ἐποίησεν, ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ εἴχοσαν· νῦν δὲ καὶ ἑωράκασιν καὶ μεμισήκασιν καὶ ἐμὲ καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου.
verses.literal: If the works not I had done among them that no other did sin not they had now however both they have seen and have hated both Me myself and the Father of Mine
verses.dgt: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not have sin; but now they have both seen and hated both me and my Father.

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτῶν γεγραμμένος ὅτι Ἐμίσησάν με δωρεάν.
verses.literal: But this is that may be fulfilled the word the in the law of them written that They hated Me without cause.’
verses.dgt: But this happened so that the word written in their Law might be fulfilled: ‘They hated me without cause.’

verses.greek: Ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὁ παράκλητος ὃν ἐγὼ πέμψω ὑμῖν παρὰ τοῦ πατρός, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἐκπορεύεται, ἐκεῖνος μαρτυρήσει περὶ ἐμοῦ·
verses.literal: When may come the Helper whom I myself will send to you from the Father the Spirit the of truth who from the Father goes forth He will bear witness concerning Me
verses.dgt: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—he will testify about me.

verses.greek: καὶ ὑμεῖς δὲ μαρτυρεῖτε, ὅτι ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστε.
verses.literal: Also you yourselves now bear witness because from the beginning with Me you are.
verses.dgt: And you also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
